weight.minorBody: Children and teens under 18 aren't weighed here. Their growth is followed on growth charts in their profile, with care and without numbers to chase.
weight.noAdults: The weight log is for adults in the family.
weight.weightError: Enter a weight between 20 and 400 kg.
weight.waistError: Enter a waist between 30 and 250 cm.
weight.note: Weigh at the same time of day, once a week is enough. Health is more than a number.

journal.adherenceHint: A third food, a third drink, a third air.
journal.childNote: Children aren't scored on what they eat. Note how the day felt instead.
